summary: Learn crop-water estimation, irrigation scheduling and field system checks. Review the course outline and see whether it fits your work.
lede: Irrigation training helps technicians, farm supervisors and agricultural advisers connect crop-water needs with field delivery decisions. Learners practise estimating crop-water requirements with FAO-56 inputs, interpreting flow and pressure readings, assessing distribution uniformity, and using findings to adjust schedules and record maintenance priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, operate or advise on irrigation delivery and need to make field decisions from crop demand, water availability and equipment condition.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with crop production, farm water delivery or irrigation equipment is useful. No coding or programming is required.
